definitions.explanation: the process of preparing oneself to go out, including dressing, grooming, and gathering belongings

examples.japanese: {身支度|みじたく}を{整|ととの}えて{出|で}かけた。
examples.english: I got ready and went out.

examples.japanese: {朝|あさ}の{身支度|みじたく}に30{分|ぷん}かかる。
examples.english: It takes me 30 minutes to get ready in the morning.

examples.japanese: {急|いそ}いで{身支度|みじたく}をして{出|で}た。
examples.english: I hurriedly got ready and left.

notes:
{身支度|みじたく} refers to the process of getting dressed and ready to go out.

ETYMOLOGY:
- {身|み}: Body, self
- {支度|したく}: Preparation

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {身支度|みじたく}を{整|ととの}える (to get oneself ready)
- {身支度|みじたく}をする (to get ready)
- {朝|あさ}の{身支度|みじたく} (morning preparations)
- {身支度|みじたく}に{時間|じかん}がかかる (to take time getting ready)

WHAT IT INCLUDES:
- Getting dressed
- Grooming (hair, makeup)
- Gathering necessary items
- General preparation to leave the house

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {準備|じゅんび} (preparation - more general)
- {支度|したく}/{仕度|したく} (preparation - broader)
- {着替|きが}え (changing clothes - more specific)
- {身|み}だしなみ (personal grooming/appearance)

REGISTER: Neutral. Common in everyday conversation.
